sentences.text: Dewi berupaya mengumpulkan semua teman sekelas lewat grup pesan.
sentences.en: Dewi tried to gather all her classmates through a messaging group.
sentences.ko: 데위는 메신저 단톡방으로 반 친구들을 모두 모으려고 애썼어요.

sentences.text: Andi bekerja sama dengan penata taman untuk halaman depan gedung.
sentences.en: Andi works with a landscaper on the building's front yard.
sentences.ko: 안디는 건물 앞마당 일로 조경사와 함께 일해요.

sentences.text: Rina sekarang bekerja sebagai penata rambut, dan Dewi langsung minta nomor teleponnya.
sentences.en: Rina now works as a hairstylist, and Dewi immediately asked for her number.
sentences.ko: 리나가 지금 미용사로 일한다고 해서 데위는 바로 전화번호를 물었어요.

sentences.text: Pemilik gedung itu seorang pebisnis muda yang sering datang menengok Andi.
sentences.en: The building's owner is a young businessman who often drops by to see Andi.
sentences.ko: 그 건물 주인은 안디를 자주 보러 오는 젊은 사업가예요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengobrol dengan seorang pebisnis yang dulu ketua kelas mereka.
sentences.en: Dewi chatted with a businessman who used to be their class president.
sentences.ko: 데위는 예전에 반장이었던 사업가와 이야기를 나눴어요.

sentences.text: Andi memakai detektor logam untuk mencari kabel di dalam tanah.
sentences.en: Andi uses a metal detector to look for cables underground.
sentences.ko: 안디는 금속 탐지기로 땅속 전선을 찾아요.

sentences.text: Di pintu masuk gedung, Dewi harus melewati detektor logam.
sentences.en: At the building entrance, Dewi had to go through a metal detector.
sentences.ko: 데위는 건물 입구에서 금속 탐지기를 통과해야 했어요.
